parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of cork, representing the Earth's surface with map details.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for geographical information and can be rotated to view different regions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the supporting base structure of the globe, made of steel, providing stability and allowing rotation of the sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the sphere in place and allows it to spin smoothly around its tilted axis.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while supporting the rotational movement of the sphere.
